difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the strict transform of a finite module along the blowup in the Fitting ideal is locally free of the original rank, given that the module is free of that rank away from the Fitting ideal. The proof computes the top Fitting ideal of the transform as the unit ideal using the blowup computation for Fitting ideals, so local freeness of the stated rank follows once the next Fitting ideal vanishes. Since the blowup algebra sits inside its localisation at the chosen element, it suffices to check vanishing after inverting, where the strict transform becomes the original localisation and the next Fitting ideal vanishes by the assumption that the module is finite locally free of the stated rank there.
